description: Wrap external dependencies behind clean interfaces so they can be swapped. Current direct usage: SQLite (storage/database.cr), HTTP::Client (fetcher/), filesystem (favicon_storage.cr), color extraction (color_extractor.cr), crypto/hashing. Architecture doc: 'Wrapper layers - wrap external dependencies instead of using them directly.' Each wrapper should define an interface (module/abstract class) with at least two implementations (real + mock) to prove replaceability.
title: Add wrapper interfaces for external dependencies
